Agent training loop: אחרי כל משימה, Agent יוצר דוח ביצוע; SyncAgent מרכז; אפשר ליצור agent‑forks (2nd gen) עם משימות אוטומטיות.

slh_daemon.sh לא מפעיל אף אחד מהם. הוא מפעיל Bot/API/Dashboard בלבד.

אבל לפני שנוגעים בקוד — כמו שביקשת — בודקים את החיבורים הקיימים.

/exec cd /app && sed -n '45,100p' internal_agent.py
3. האם ה־Mission Runner הוא רק TEST או יכול להריץ Mission אמיתי
/exec cd /app && sed -n '60,125p' mission_runner.py
4. האם יש כבר loop/queue בתוך ה־Mission system

מוצרים / Store / checkout:

לקוח → מוצר/שירות → תשלום → אימות → Wallet/Ledger → fulfillment → reward/commission → agent → mission → execution → audit

Removed 10 additional dead one-off fix scripts (fix_add_broadcast.py, fix_lock.py, onboard_patch.py, etc). Tagged gold-v1.0 (post economy-fix, pre-cleanup) and gold-v2.0-clean (post full cleanup) as rollback points. journal.json:    "text": "SESSION 4-JUL-2026 PART 3 - Economic engine audit: Found marketplace.py wrote to /app/marketplace.json (ephemeral container disk, NOT Volume) - active data-loss risk, would reset on every deploy. FIXED: changed STORE_FILE path to state/marketplace.json, preserved existing data (health_check, task_plugin, agent_os, junk_cleaner plugins) by copying to new location before code change. Verified live on Railway post-deploy - code and file both confirmed at new path. ALSO DISCOVERED (not yet fixed): (1) TWO competing /join handlers registered - learn_handlers.py and welcome_handler.py both claim commands=[join], likely causing referral flow to silently fail since welcome_handler writes db[students] without referral_code field that learn_handlers /referral expects. (2) welcome_handler.py and learn_handlers.py bypass state_manager.py entirely, doing raw json.load/dump on relative db.json path instead of using the centralized DB access built last session - same single-source-of-truth risk as journal.json had. (3) Local Termux state/db.json was significantly stale vs Railway live db.json (missing students/courses/admins keys) - must always pull live data via /exec before doing local DB work. (4) orphaned join_fix.py file present in root, unclear if still relevant. NEXT SESSION: resolve duplicate /join handlers, migrate welcome_handler.py and learn_handlers.py to use state_manager.py, decide fate of join_fix.py."
